Javokhir Sindarov – the next World Champion?
rubriker._rss_content: In a few days, Javokhir Sindarov will face Gukesh in Geneva for the World Championship title. Sindarov is currently fourth in the world rankings, but by the numbers, he is already the best player in the world. Over the twelve months leading up to the World Championship match, Sindarov has achieved an average performance rating of 2812 – higher than any other player. Over the past year, Sindarov has gained 61 Elo points, while Gukesh has lost 53. No wonder Sindarov is favourite in the World Championship match. | Photo: Nils Rohde

rubriker.title: Review: The English Opening – An overview
rubriker._rss_content: Jochen Schwarz is a club player from Bremen who enjoys playing the English Opening (1.c4), historically also known as the “Bremen Opening”. He has taken a look at the most important video courses in the ChessBase range and put together an overview. Some courses present a repertoire for White based on the English Opening, while others offer a repertoire for Black against it. There are also 60-minute courses devoted to specific variations.

rubriker.title: Chess by the Numbers: Explore a decade of FIDE Data, powered by Salesforce Agentforce
rubriker._rss_content: The official website of the Salesforce FIDE World Championship now includes an interactive "Chess by the Numbers" section, using more than a decade of FIDE data to explore trends across the game. Powered by Salesforce technology, the feature covers player ratings, national federations, participation, women in chess, tournament activity and historical rankings. It also includes head-to-head statistics for Gukesh Dommaraju and Javokhir Sindarov ahead of their World Championship match. | Image: FIDE

rubriker.title: Se puso en marcha el Campeonato Mundial Sub-20 en Caracas
rubriker._rss_content: El Campeonato Mundial de Ajedrez Sub-20 se ha puesto en marcha en Caracas, con la participación de 136 jugadores de 32 países en las categorías abierta y femenina. Los torneos, que se disputan a 11 rondas, se celebran del 18 al 27 de noviembre en el Hotel Eurobuilding. La presidenta de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, y el presidente de la Asamblea Nacional, Jorge Rodríguez, realizaron el primer movimiento ceremonial, mientras que el presidente de la FIDE, Timur Turlov, asistió a los actos inaugurales junto a autoridades nacionales del ajedrez y el deporte. | Fotos: Federación Venezolana de Ajedrez

rubriker.title: Toda la historia del ajedrez en una sola base de datos: Mega Database 2027
rubriker._rss_content: 12,5 millones de partidas, desde el siglo XV hasta nuestros días, 115.000 de ellas comentadas: la Mega Database de ChessBase abarca toda la historia del ajedrez y es un recurso de valor incalculable para la preparación de torneos y partidas. La nueva edición, Mega 2027, acaba de salir al mercado. En comparación con Mega 2026, se han añadido casi 900.000 partidas de todas las épocas. Y esa no es la única novedad.
